data.title: Weather Forecast for Thursday
data.content:
Riyadh, November 26, 2026, SPA -- According to the National Center for Meteorology, thunderstorms accompanied by hail and active winds are expected to continue in parts of Jazan, Aseer, Al-Baha, and Makkah regions. Fog may form overnight and in the early morning in parts of these regions, as well as in parts of Al-Jouf and Northern Borders regions. In parts of Eastern Region, fog may reduce visibility to zero or near zero.
    Winds over the Red Sea will be northwesterly to northerly at speeds of 15–37 km/h in the northern part. In the central part, winds will be northeasterly to northerly at 10–25 km/h, turning northwesterly to westerly in the afternoon. In the southern part, winds will be southeasterly to southwesterly at 10–25 km/h. As rain-bearing thunderclouds form, wind speeds may exceed 50 km/h in the central and southern parts. Waves will range from half a meter to one and a half meters; the sea will be calm to moderate.
    In the Arabian Gulf, winds will be westerly to northwesterly at speeds of 8–28 km/h in the northern part and northerly to northwesterly at 10–25 km/h in the southern part. Waves will range from half a meter to one meter; the sea will be calm.
    -- SPA
